summary: Full e2e testing of STEAM Hub. Backend: 26 pytest cases across auth (register/login/me/JWT), quizzes (list/get/attempt scoring), activities (list+subject/difficulty filters), ideas (create/list/filter/like), seed-data idempotency - 26/26 PASSED. Frontend: landing page, protected-route redirects, register auto-login, login with seeded creds, dashboard stats (Quizzes Available = 3), quiz take-flow with option select/Next/Previous/Submit/result badge, activities list + filter dropdown, ideas create + like increment, Content Hub tabs/search/category filter, logout (token cleared, redirect) - all PASSED except drag-and-drop matching, which is completely broken due to react-beautiful-dnd being incompatible with React 19.

minor.issue: Unauthenticated and destructive (deletes ALL activities and system quizzes). Any anonymous caller can wipe/reset content. Should require auth or be admin-only.

No per-user like tracking - same user can like the same idea unlimited times ($inc only). Also returns 404 when likes already at the same value is not an issue, but modified_count==0 semantics can misreport.
attempt_data typed as raw dict (no Pydantic model) - no validation of answers payload; empty answers silently score 0.
Returns correct_answer for every question to unauthenticated clients - answers are leakable before submission.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Drag-and-drop matching is non-functional. Console throws 'react-beautiful-dnd: Invariant failed: isDropDisabled must be a boolean' (10 occurrences on activity open) because react-beautiful-dnd@13.1.1 relies on function-component defaultProps, which React 19.2 ignores. Verified with both keyboard drag (Space/Arrow/Space) and a 15-step real mouse drag: no item ever lands in a drop zone, all 4 zones remain 'Drop item here', and 'Check Answers' stays disabled - so the score screen is unreachable through the UI.

Active-route highlight is wrong: isActive uses location.pathname.startsWith(path); since every path starts with '/', the Home link is highlighted on every page simultaneously with the real active link (verified on /dashboard, /quiz, /activities).
Two CTA buttons at the bottom of the page have empty onClick handlers ({/* Navigate to activities */} and {/* Navigate to quizzes */}) - dead buttons that do nothing when clicked.

Desktop and mobile menus render duplicate data-testid values (nav-home, nav-quiz, logout-btn/mobile-logout-btn partially). Duplicate testids force .first/.last in tests; consider prefixing mobile ones.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot be completed end-to-end; library-level failure blocks the whole feature (score API/state never reached).

issues: 'Learning Progress 65%' and 'Streak 7 days' are hardcoded mock values not backed by any API - misleading to users
'Your Learning Path' subject progress bars are also static
Ideas collection is now empty (no seeded ideas), so the page shows an empty-state until a user posts - consider seeding 2-3 sample ideas for demo value

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix drag-and-drop. Recommended: replace react-beautiful-dnd with the maintained React 19-compatible fork @hello-pangea/dnd (yarn add @hello-pangea/dnd, yarn remove react-beautiful-dnd, change the import in ActivitiesPage.js - API is identical). Alternative stop-gap: pass explicit booleans to every Droppable/Draggable (isDropDisabled={false} isCombineEnabled={false} ignoreContainerClipping={false} and shouldRespectForcePress={false}) since React 19 no longer applies defaultProps.
Fix Navbar isActive: use exact match for '/' (e.g. path === '/' ? location.pathname === '/' : location.pathname.startsWith(path)).
Wire up or remove the two dead ContentHub CTA buttons (empty onClick).
Protect POST /api/seed-data (auth/admin) - currently anonymous callers can delete all activities.
Strip correct_answer from GET /api/quizzes / GET /api/quizzes/{id} responses and validate the attempt payload with a Pydantic model.
Replace hardcoded Dashboard stats (65% progress, 7-day streak) with real data or label them clearly as demo.
critical_code_review_comments: react-beautiful-dnd is deprecated and incompatible with React 19 (defaultProps ignored for function components) - this is the root cause of the broken activities feature, not app logic.

ActivitiesPage.js (506 lines) duplicates the entire seeded activity dataset as a client-side fallback (setSampleActivities); this hides API failures and is dead code now that /api/activities returns 3 activities. Remove or split the file.
ActivitiesPage filter mixes subject and difficulty into a single 'filter' state; a user cannot filter by subject AND difficulty together, and the dropdown label 'Filter by...' is ambiguous.
server.py uses deprecated Pydantic .dict() and FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to .model_dump() and lifespan handlers.
Unused import 'from passlib.hash import bcrypt' in server.py alongside bcrypt_lib.
seed_data_creation: Registered throwaway users (TEST_user*, qa*) and TEST_ ideas during testing; all removed afterwards via /app/backend/tests/cleanup_test_data.py. Quizzes/activities re-seeded via POST /api/seed-data (3 + 3). Note: db.ideas is now empty (there were no pre-existing non-test ideas).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v` for full API regression (26 tests, all green). Frontend verified: landing CTA, /auth register+login, protected-route redirects for /quiz /activities /ideas /dashboard, dashboard stats testids (total-quizzes=3, ideas-shared), quiz full flow (option-N, next/previous-question-btn, quiz-score), ideas create+like, ContentHub tabs/search/category, logout clears localStorage token. ONLY remaining failure: ActivitiesPage drag-and-drop. After the dnd library swap, retest by dragging [data-testid^="drag-item-"] into [data-testid^="drop-zone-"] (keyboard drag: focus item, Space, ArrowRight, Space works with @hello-pangea/dnd) and assert [data-testid="activity-score"] appears after check-answers-btn.
rca_of_the_issue: React 19 stopped applying defaultProps to function components. react-beautiful-dnd@13.1.1 defines Droppable's isDropDisabled/isCombineEnabled/ignoreContainerClipping via defaultProps, so they arrive as undefined and the library's invariant ('isDropDisabled must be a boolean') throws during Droppable validation, disabling the DragDropContext. Reproduction: log in, open /activities, start any activity, open console -> 10 rbd invariant errors; attempt any mouse or keyboard drag -> nothing drops, Check Answers stays disabled. Mitigation: migrate to @hello-pangea/dnd (drop-in) or pass explicit boolean props.
